title: Alma counsels Helaman
summary: Alma counsels his son Helaman to keep God’s commandments, remember the captivity of their fathers, and trust God through trials.

explicit_facts.text: Alma addresses Helaman as his son and counsels him to keep God’s commandments.
Alma says their fathers were in bondage and God delivered them in their afflictions.

unspecified_visual_details: The place and time of the counsel.

title: Alma remembers his sins
summary: Alma recounts being tormented by the memory of his sins, recognizing his rebellion and the harm he had led others toward.

title: Alma dreads judgment
summary: Alma longs to be banished and cease to exist rather than stand before God to be judged; his torment lasts three days and three nights.
